name: soundpack
description: Sound packs for Claude Code events: minimal, retro or nature.

pack.title: Sound pack
pack.description: minimal: soft bells and marimba. retro: 8-bit chip tunes. nature: wind chime, birds, water and wood.

done.title: Sound when a long turn ends
done.description: Play the done sound when Claude finishes a turn that took longer than the long-turn limit.

error.title: Sound when a command fails
error.description: Play the error sound when a Bash command fails (at most once every 8 seconds).

permission.title: Sound when Claude needs approval
permission.description: Play the permission sound when a permission prompt opens.

green.title: Sound when tests pass
green.description: Play the green sound when a test command finishes without failures.

longTurnSeconds.title: Long turn (seconds)
longTurnSeconds.description: A turn counts as long, and gets the done sound, when it took more than this many seconds.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Loudness: 0 is silent, 1 is the clips' own level, up to 4.
